purpose: 第一批可沉淀测试能力草案；先固化功能意图、动作、断言、归因和资料缺口，后续由脚本生成 registry extension。

capabilities.intent: 连续或短间隔播放唤醒词，验证设备是否出现连续未唤醒、卡死、重启或日志中断。
assertions: wake_success_count / valid_rounds meets configured threshold
max_consecutive_wake_failures <= configured limit
no device reboot, serial silence, or logger interruption during run

attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: playback ok and serial alive but CP/AP/ASR wake evidence missing repeatedly
attribution.device_or_environment: audio playback failure, serial interruption, reboot, or sound path abnormal
attribution.requirement_gap: round count, interval, or threshold not configured

capabilities.intent: 用随机间隔触发唤醒，观察不同设备状态下唤醒稳定性和状态残留。
assertions: random_interval_wake_rate meets configured threshold
state_abnormal_count == 0 unless expected
consecutive_failure_segments are reported separately

attribution.timing_ambiguous: wake audio effective point overlaps recognition timeout gray zone
attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: safe timing but wake evidence missing
attribution.requirement_gap: interval distribution or state policy not configured

capabilities.intent: 统计成功唤醒样本从唤醒词结束到设备提示音/TTS/唤醒反馈开始的耗时。
assertions: latency metrics include avg, min, max, p95 when sample size is enough
failed wake rounds are excluded from latency average and listed separately
over_threshold_samples are listed with evidence

attribution.requirement_gap: latency start/end marker or threshold is not confirmed
attribution.script_gap: serial timestamp resolution cannot support configured precision
attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: confirmed successful wake response exceeds threshold

capabilities.intent: 从需求文档抽取命令词全集，与可播放/可执行测试集比对，输出覆盖率和缺失项。
assertions: covered_command_count / expected_command_count is reported
missing_commands are listed
commands without oracle are marked NEEDS_REVIEW instead of FAIL

attribution.requirement_gap: expected command list cannot be extracted or conflicts between documents
attribution.data_gap: command exists in requirements but no audio or playback source is available
attribution.script_gap: parser cannot classify document table structure

capabilities.intent: 按文本长度、数字参数、语速/停顿标签拆分命令词专项结果，避免整体识别率掩盖局部问题。
assertions: group_accuracy and group_confusion are reported
numeric_boundary_commands are listed separately
synthetic variants are not treated as official failure before review

attribution.data_gap: variant audio is not available and TTS synthesis is not confirmed
attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: official reviewed sample fails in a safe execution window

capabilities.intent: 构造唤醒词和离线命令词短间隔任务，按唤醒失败、命令未识别、命令识别错误、执行异常拆分失败原因。
assertions: overall_success requires wake success and command recognition correctness
failure_stage is one of wake_failed, command_empty, command_wrong, action_abnormal, environment_blocked
interval metrics are reported separately for 500, 800, 1000, 1500 ms

attribution.requirement_gap: offline oneshot support or interval matrix is not confirmed
attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: official interval audio has wake evidence but command stage fails

capabilities.intent: 自动寻找可稳定进入自播状态的前置：优先联网查天气/播歌，其次扫描离线命令播报时长，选择最长播报作为打断前置。
assertions: selected prerequisite has detectable TTS/audio start and end markers
duration is long enough for configured interrupt injection point
unstable prerequisites are excluded and reported

attribution.environment_blocked: network unavailable or no self-play command can be detected
attribution.requirement_gap: interrupt injection point or success criterion is not configured
attribution.script_gap: TTS duration cannot be parsed from available logs

capabilities.intent: 从需求文档抽取自由说意图、slot、核心说法和长尾说法，先完成覆盖率与 oracle 草案。
assertions: intent_coverage and slot_coverage are reported
high_frequency and non_high_frequency buckets are separated when labels exist
pure_slot candidates are reviewed before formal execution

attribution.data_gap: phrase exists but no audio or synthesis policy is available

capabilities.intent: 基于需求说法生成前缀、后缀、插入语和口语化候选，用于摸底泛化能力，正式结论需人工或需求确认。
assertions: reviewed variants should hit the base intent or accepted equivalent intent
unreviewed variants are reported as exploratory results
unsupported colloquial expressions are listed separately

attribution.data_gap: synthetic audio cannot be generated or approved
attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: reviewed and accepted variant fails recognition

capabilities.intent: 构造唤醒词和在线语料短间隔任务，分别统计唤醒、在线 ASR、云端/网络失败。
assertions: overall_success requires wake success and expected online ASR text
network or cloud errors are BLOCKED or ENVIRONMENT_FAIL, not firmware fail
interval metrics are reported separately

attribution.environment_blocked: hotspot, device online, cloud, or SID path unavailable
attribution.requirement_gap: online oneshot support or expected ASR text missing
attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: safe online state but ASR text missing or wrong

capabilities.intent: 用短句、长句、尾弱音和带停顿语料验证端点检测，统计截断、超时和句准。
assertions: truncated samples are counted separately from text_wrong
timeout samples are counted separately from recognition_empty
formal pass requires reviewed VAD dataset and truncation tolerance

attribution.requirement_gap: truncation tolerance or VAD dataset is not confirmed
attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: reviewed VAD sample is cut or timed out under normal network

capabilities.intent: 先沉淀热点/联网恢复和基础弱网/断网验证，严格带宽/延迟/丢包弱网待网络整形环境补充。
assertions: online prerequisite must pass before online recognition assertions
network failures are attributed to environment unless device stays offline after recovery
recovery events are logged

attribution.environment_blocked: hotspot off, device not attached, cloud unavailable
attribution.device_or_firmware: network restored but device does not reconnect within configured timeout
attribution.requirement_gap: weak network parameters are not configured

capabilities.intent: 在无主动播放唤醒词的窗口内监听唤醒事件，统计单位时长误唤醒和设备异常。
assertions: false_wake_frequency is reported as events per hour
device reboot, serial stop, or process abnormal are reported separately
audio review is required before final acoustic cause classification

attribution.needs_audio_review: serial wake occurred but acoustic source is unknown
attribution.requirement_gap: duration or frequency threshold not configured

capabilities.intent: 所有测试统一二次复核原始证据，区分脚本误判、设备/环境、固件/算法和需求不清。
assertions: runner FAIL with raw PASS is SCRIPT_FALSE_FAIL
missing prerequisites become BLOCKED instead of firmware FAIL
ambiguous requirement becomes NEEDS_REQUIREMENT_CONFIRMATION

attribution.firmware_or_algorithm: all preconditions pass and expected behavior missing
